BiblicalUsage: Abimael is a son of Joktan, named in the table of nations in Genesis 10:28 and repeated in 1 Chronicles 1:22. He belongs to the line of Shem that spreads through Arabia — one of thirteen sons of Joktan whose descendants settle the south.
TheologicalSignificance: A name in the table of nations, with no story of his own — and still part of the record of how the earth was peopled after the flood. I believe the table of nations is the Bible's way of saying every people has a place in God's story, even the ones we never hear about again.
